name: Covered Wagon
defects: Right/front wheel is only a partial visible crescent behind the drawbar, smaller than the other wheels and not clearly connected to an axle.
The tongue/drawbar appears as two thick beams that merge into the wagon underside with no clear pivot or hitch hardware.
Canvas cover ribs and side panels are lumpy and melted together rather than forming consistent separate hoops.
Front canvas opening and wooden front board overlap awkwardly, making the interior support structure unclear.

name: Cornbread
defects: Top crust is split into oversized rounded pillow-like sections instead of a continuous natural crust
Central exposed crumb area makes the surrounding crust look slightly fused/melted

name: Rocking Chair
defects: Top back rail is asymmetrical: the left end blends into the rail while the right end looks like a separate rounded block.
Back slats are unevenly spaced and slightly warped/tilted.
Lower front crossbar appears to intersect the front legs rather than join cleanly.

name: Canteen
defects: Top cap is tilted/off-center on the neck and does not seat cleanly.
Blue ring handle behind the cap has no clear attachment point and appears fused into the cap/neck area.
Shoulder strap disappears behind the bottle and reappears without a clear continuous path.
Front horizontal strap ends at side keepers with unclear continuation around the back of the canteen.
Buckle/slider on the upper strap is simplified and appears partly fused to the strap rather than threaded through it.

name: Canvas Tent
defects: Small orange pole nub on the rear-left side appears to grow out of the canvas rather than continuing as a visible structural pole.
Front rolled tie/peg cylinders look fused into the slanted poles and fabric instead of being clearly strapped on.
Left and right front rolled tie assemblies are asymmetric in placement and attachment.
Some front fabric flaps have melted/soft edges and unclear connections to the poles and floor.

name: Bean Pot
defects: Wooden spoon head is malformed: it looks like a spoon/fork hybrid with split prongs instead of a normal solid bowl.
Spoon bowl appears partly melted into or hidden by the beans, making its exact edge unclear.
Pot handles are slightly asymmetric in shape and attachment position.

name: Saguaro
defects: small flower behind the main top flower is partially hidden and has no visible stem or clear attachment point

name: Rope Loop
defects: The knot is modeled as a smooth collar or band around the rope rather than a real tied knot.
Several rope segments at the knot appear to merge or penetrate each other with no clear over-under path.
The lower dangling section forms a closed teardrop loop with no visible loose free end, making the lasso construction physically impossible.
The rope topology is ambiguous where the large loop enters the knot; it is unclear which strand continues through.

name: Skillet Bread
defects: Only one clear pour spout is visible on the skillet rim; the matching opposite spout is missing or hidden, making the pan asymmetrical.
The cornbread wedges are fused together at the center rather than clearly separated by cuts.
The small side fire pit is not positioned under the skillet and appears decorative rather than functional for heating it.

name: Trail Boots
defects: Laces have no visible bow, knot, or loose ends; the cords terminate into the eyelet blocks.
Several lace segments appear fused into solid yellow eyelet pads rather than passing through real hooks or holes.
The over-under routing of the crossed laces is inconsistent and partly melted together.
Some outsole tread blocks are uneven, rounded, and slightly fused/melted together instead of separate rugged lugs.

name: Depot Sandwich
defects: The visible lower bread slice reads as a rounded rectangle while the top slice is triangular, making the sandwich construction geometrically inconsistent.

name: Station Clock
defects: clock face has unevenly spaced tick marks and appears to be missing at least one hour marker

name: Platform Bench
defects: Small support block under the right side of the seat appears suspended and does not clearly reach the floor.
Some seat/back planks merge into the side posts without clear separate ends, giving slightly fused construction.

name: Picnic Basket
defects: Woven strips are not a consistent over-under construction; several bands merge into each other and terminate abruptly.
Only the right handle pivot is clearly built; the left handle attachment is missing or hidden, making the handle look partly grown out of the lid/side.
Handle arch is slightly asymmetric in thickness and curvature, especially near the right attachment.
Front latch strap blends into the lid edge and has no clear matching catch on the basket body.

name: Depot House
defects: Left and right side roof supports/brackets are asymmetric and slightly melted into the roof edge and wall.
Brick courses are inconsistent and warped around the arches and corners.
The front door halves and window panes are slightly uneven/asymmetric.
Railroad track at the bottom has warped/uneven sleepers and rails that appear as extra parallel strips rather than clean continuous rails.
No text or digits are present.
